newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro shines on Oslo Bourse on profit announcement.
newsitem.headline: Hydro shines on Oslo Bourse on profit announcement.

text.p: The Norwegian share index was lifted on Monday by industrial group Norsk Hydro, whose stock jumped an incredible 6.93 percent following the release of the company's first-quarter profits.
Oslo's Total index closed 1.32 percent higher at 1,089.26 points in turnover worth 739 million crowns, including 293 million traded in Hydro.
Hydro, which has a 20 percent weighting on the Total index and is Norway's largest listed company, released first-quarter net profits of 1.54 billion crowns that beat market consensus forecasts.
The stock closed 23 crowns higher at 355 crowns.
Five out of six analysts contacted by Reuters said they would upgrade expectations of Hydro's Agriculture Division because of the results.

Telecommunications group Nera, which has tumbled following a profit warning last week, recovered some lost ground and closed 3.41 percent higher at 318 crowns. Nera will present its first-quarter results on Thursday.
